confidence_notes: Coffee and restaurant anchors rest on aggregator averages and national Italian espresso and cappuccino ranges, and the sources disagree (dinner for two ranges from about EUR 60 to 128). Beer, cocktail and wine have no direct Lecce price data: beer is a bounded estimate, cocktail is about 2.25x beer and wine glass about 1.1x beer, with the wine figure checked against a university canteen price of EUR 2.30. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge for July peak season; no booking pages or listings were inspected and no accommodation searches were run. FX: 0.6947 USD per AUD matches recent RBA page entries but the 2026-10-16 date comes from a third-party converter that cites the RBA, and the RBA page metadata was inconsistent, so the date was not confirmed on rba.gov.au. Euro-denominated estimates were converted at roughly 1.12 USD per EUR, derived from the same converter's cross rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is southern Italian provincial-city pricing. Restaurant anchors come from Lecce aggregator averages. Coffee is set from national espresso and cappuccino ranges adjusted down for southern pricing. Drink anchors are relative to beer where direct data is weak. Accommodation is a holistic estimate against typical southern Italian peak-season levels.
